## Overview

Structural/behavioral directive that exposes viewport breakpoint signals and
applies CSS classes based on the default breakpoints. Useful for responsive
logic without media queries.

- **Kind:** Directive
- **Export as:** `qzViewportMatch`
- **Source:** [packages/core/src/viewport/viewport-match.directive.ts:31](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/core/src/viewport/viewport-match.directive.ts#L31)

## Selector

```text
[qzViewportMatch]
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `minWidth` | `number \| null` | `null` |  | Custom min-width breakpoint to match. |
| `maxWidth` | `number \| null` | `null` |  | Custom max-width breakpoint to match. |

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `readonly matchesMin` | `Signal<boolean>` | Whether the viewport matches the custom minWidth (if provided). |
